objective: A frozen exploratory census: loops of r = 5 to 8 rule-60 rings with law (12,12), ring sizes 4 to 16, contact positions from {2, floor(s/2), ceil(s/2), s - 2} up to rotation; whether each is balanced and whether every contact binds both its rings at every lag to 400.
status: Supported 2026-11-08 (exploratory; H1 holds): of 65,472 loops of 5 to 8 rule-60 rings at sizes 4 to 16, all 5,354 balanced ones keep every contact binding both rings to lag 400 through the chain-end witnesses; 11,322 unbalanced ones also persist to lag 400, so balance is sufficient, not necessary.
title: A census of loops of five to eight rings
